entities.summary: Britain's naval force that dominated global seas from the defeat of the Spanish Armada (1588) through World War II. The Royal Navy protected British trade routes, enforced colonial rule, suppressed the transatlantic slave trade after 1807, and served as the model for modern professional navies worldwide.
